observed_original_abi.convention_evidence: The derived ABI record abstains: no stack-argument read and no positive receiver evidence, and the body is byte-identical under __cdecl, __stdcall, __thiscall and __fastcall. A zero-parameter leaf ending in a bare RET is declared __cdecl so the caller owns cleanup, which the record states as INFERRED.
observed_original_abi.receiver_evidence: ECX is never read in any form (derived inference R2, OBSERVED).

observed_contract.summary: Reads the word the container holds at its active-star displacement, and when that word is non-zero returns the word stored at displacement 0x48 of the object it points at. When the star word is zero the function returns zero.
observed_contract.no_container_guard: The absolute word 0x016dda8c is loaded with no test of its own and dereferenced immediately. The only null test in the body guards the active-star word, not the container. A null container therefore faults here exactly as the machine does; the reconstruction reproduces this and does not add a guard.
observed_contract.read_only: Both loads are plain reads. The body contains no store, so neither the container nor the star object is written.
observed_contract.two_exits: Two RET sites. The taken path returns the word at star+0x48; the fallthrough zero-extends EAX and returns it, so the not-taken path yields zero rather than leaving the loaded word in EAX.
observed_contract.no_dispatch: The body names no indirect transfer, so the two loads cannot be a virtual call and the return value is data, not a dispatch result.

unresolved_questions: The calling convention is undetermined by the body. __cdecl is declared because it is the least committal zero-parameter leaf shape and agrees with caller cleanup; __stdcall with zero callee cleanup is byte-identical here.

Whether the returned word is genuinely an intrusive_ptr<Simulator::cStarRecord> payload, as the SDK offset column suggests, or a differently-typed 32-bit word that merely sits at 0x48, is not settled by this body's own listing. The reconstruction claims the displacement and the zero-guard and nothing about what the word addresses.
The caller's domain is not established. 74 caller functions is consistent with a widely-used identity accessor but fan-in alone does not show what any of them do with the value.
